thesis: The episode introduces Richard Lawrence, chairman of the Overlook Group, a $5 billion investment organization focused on Asian equities that he founded in 1991. The discussion highlights the firm's disciplined investment philosophy, which has driven an annualized 14.5% return and a capital-weighted return nearly identical to its time-weighted return, resulting in a capital base of $4 billion in investment gains on top of $1 billion in contributed capital.
